title: A BIGGER CROWBAR SWING
why: His note of 2026-10-13: the melee swing animation needs to be larger and more prominent. The crowbar now sweeps 140 degrees across your aim, drawn 1.6 times as long and thick, with a bold pale swoosh behind it that fades within about a sixth of a second and reaches as far as the blow does. Your body leans into the swing, and a hit lands with a short flash, a burst of sparks at the struck point and a small kick of the screen. Only the picture changed: the damage, reach and cooldown of the blow are the same.
now: The crowbar swing is bigger and bolder: a longer bar, a wide pale swoosh, a flash and sparks where it lands, and a lean into the blow.

edits.replacement: if(!G.sim){ spark(_me.x,_me.y,'#cdd6dd',10,200); sfx('clank',_me.x,_me.y); if(G.barT>0){ meleeFoley('hit',_me.x,_me.y); meleeImpact(sh.x,sh.y,_me.x,_me.y,_me.r); } }   // v26.xx (meleebig): and the crowbar lands with a flash, sparks and a small kick
